title: Vault Census

scenario.intro: The Librarian wants a headcount of every vault, floor by floor. The new Attic keeps going missing from the report.
scenario.goal: One query: `GROUP BY` each vault with its item count and total, keep empty vaults with `LEFT JOIN`, and filter with `HAVING`.

objective: A census of every vault, lowest floor first, empty ones included.
rules: One row per vault: `name`, `items` (how many) and `total` (sum of prices, `0` when empty).
Every vault appears, even one with no items, lowest `floor` first.
Only vaults with at least `min_items` items (default 0).
One query for the whole census, not one per vault.
starter_code:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from harness.vault import open_vault

# The vault: an in-memory SQLite database (tables vaults and items, see SCHEMA).
# The Attic is new: it has no items yet.
SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE vaults (name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, floor INTEGER, keeper TEXT);
INSERT INTO vaults VALUES ('North', 1, 'Ada'), ('South', 2, 'Grace'), ('Deep', -1, 'Linus'),
  ('Attic', 3, '{{keeper}}');
CREATE TABLE items (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, vault TEXT, price INTEGER);
INSERT INTO items VALUES
  (1, 'Crown', 'North', 950), (2, 'Map', 'North', 12), (3, 'Lantern', 'North', 40),
  (4, 'Key', 'South', 25), (5, 'Ledger', 'South', 60),
  (6, '{{gem}}', 'Deep', 700), (7, 'Rope', 'Deep', 8);
"""
db = open_vault(SCHEMA)
app = FastAPI()


@app.get("/census")
async def census(min_items: int = 0) -> dict[str, list[dict[str, object]]]:
    # >>> EDIT START
    rows = db.execute(
        "SELECT v.name, COUNT(*), SUM(i.price) FROM vaults v JOIN items i ON i.vault = v.name "
        "GROUP BY v.name"
    ).fetchall()
    # <<< EDIT END
    return {"vaults": [{"name": n, "items": c, "total": s} for n, c, s in rows]}
reference_solution:
rows = db.execute(
    "SELECT v.name, COUNT(i.id), COALESCE(SUM(i.price), 0) FROM vaults v "
    "LEFT JOIN items i ON i.vault = v.name "
    "GROUP BY v.name HAVING COUNT(i.id) >= ? ORDER BY v.floor",
    (min_items,),
).fetchall()

hints.text: A plain JOIN drops vaults with no matching items. LEFT JOIN keeps every vault and fills the item columns with NULL.
COUNT(i.id) counts only real items (NULLs don't count); COALESCE(SUM(i.price), 0) turns an empty sum into 0. HAVING filters groups, WHERE filters rows.
... LEFT JOIN items i ON i.vault = v.name GROUP BY v.name HAVING COUNT(i.id) >= ? ORDER BY v.floor, with (min_items,).

dialogue.start: Count every vault for me. Yes, the empty Attic too. Especially the Attic.
dialogue.success: Every floor counted, in one trip to the shelves. Tidy work.
dialogue.fail: The census is missing a vault, or the counts don't add up.
